source.geometryMethod: deterministic card, segmented-trunk and closed-caster generator
source.textureMethod: four transparent ImageGen foliage sources conditioned into one alpha-safe PBR atlas

imageGenSources.promptSummary: Transparent photoreal temperate autumn branch cluster with burnt orange, ochre, muted red and olive leaves, visible twigs and irregular gaps under flat overcast light.
Transparent photoreal broad spruce/pine branch cluster with dark needles, visible twigs and gaps; no whole-tree or Christmas-tree symmetry.
Transparent top-oblique radial date-palm fronds with realistic leaflets and gaps; no trunk, coconuts, ground or low-poly styling.
Transparent photoreal fan clump of thin tapered grass blades with natural crossings and gaps; no soil, pot, flowers or low-poly treatment.

material.name: extended-foliage-v1-pbr
material.atlasLayout: 2x2: autumn branch, conifer branch, palm fronds, grass tuft; opaque bark swatch in guarded atlas corner

reviews.note: WebGPU cardinal proof of the halo-free alpha silhouette and corrected medium-brown trunk.
WebGPU halo-free proof after increasing LOD0 branch density from the rejected sparse first pass.
WebGPU proof of the halo-free radial frond read and segmented grounded trunk.
WebGPU proof of halo-free realistic alpha grass at an eight-triangle LOD0.

rejections.reason: Transparent atlas pixels made trunks render nearly black; an opaque guarded bark swatch and point UV mapping replaced it.
Nine cards exposed too much pole-like trunk in cardinal review; the accepted LOD0 uses fifteen cards while remaining only 82 triangles.
Partial-alpha source texels produced bright strokes around leaf and grass silhouettes in the live WebGPU scene. Production uses a strict 0.85 mask without alpha-to-coverage.
